{{Dialogue|Berkelium Shyre|Sorry, Juno. I don't mean to be pushy. I just wish you'd stay.|Juno Eclipse|I'll be back. Don't worry about that.|Shyre|No, I mean stay. Here. With me.|attr=Berkelium Shyre and Juno Eclipse|src=<ref name="TFU2n" />}}
'''Berkelium Shyre''', also known by the codename "'''The Repairman'''," was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. By the year [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], he secretly worked for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], an insurrectionist [[organization]] that had [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|declared]] [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|So, the fleet&hellip;''"<br />"''It's not far from here. In the Inner Rim, just off the Hydian Way. Ever heard of a place called Nordra?|[[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]] and Berkelium Shyre|<ref name="TFU2n" />}}
Around [[11 BBY/Legends|11 BBY]], Berkelium Shyre migrated to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] during its transition from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] rule to a state of independence. An anti-[[Imperialization/Legends|Imperialist]], Shyre joined the local resistance movement, but later lost the entire lower half of his body when a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] exploded in the middle of a group of [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]] he had been helping. He created [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic replacements]] to replace his destroyed [[Limb/Legends|limbs]], thus making him a [[Cyborg/Legends|machine]] from the waist down. While he was no longer able to serve in a [[Soldier/Legends|combatant role]], Shyre adapted to his injured state by applying his skills as a [[Technician/Legends|technician]]. In public, he became a [[Merchant/Legends|businessman]] and owner of a maintenance store; privately, he continued to participate in activities that undermined the Empire's hold over Malastare.<ref name="TFUn">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>

After living on Malastare for ten years, Shyre became one of the earliest supporters of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], approximately six months after<ref name="TFU2n" /> the [[2 BBY/Legends|start]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] [[Civil war|conflict]] between the Alliance and the Empire.<ref name="TFUn" /> His support for the budding rebellion against [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] involved working in secret to strengthen the Alliance's influence over Malastare. One of his primary contacts in the Rebellion was [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] who defected from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and joined the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] as [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']]. The two developed a friendship, which later evolved into a one-sided romantic attraction on Shyre's part. Eclipse still grieved over the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galen Marek]],<ref name="TFU2n" /> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|former apprentice]] whom she fell in love with just prior to Marek's [[Battle on Death Star I|demise on the]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="TFUn" />

Seeking to regroup with the Alliance [[Fleet/Legends|Fleet]], Eclipse visited Shyre on Malastare and inquired about its secret coordinates. Shyre revealed that the fleet was hiding in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], just off of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. Before she could leave, Shyre tried to convince her to remain with him on Malastare, in the hopes that they could start a life together. Eclipse, still unable to overcome her grief over Marek's death, rejected Shyre's advances.<ref name="TFU2n" />

When [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]]&mdash;a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and survivor of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]&mdash;arrived on Malastare shortly after [[Rescue of Rahm Kota|escaping from captivity]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], Shyre provided sanctuary to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|general]] and his [[Kota's squad|squad]]. Shortly afterward, Shyre met [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]], an [[Cloning/Legends|unstable clone]] of Marek that Vader created on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] in an attempt to replace the original apprentice. Unaware of the clone's origin, Shyre mistook Starkiller to be the same man that Juno Eclipse loved. The clone, however, regarded Shyre as a security risk. Thus, he performed a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind wipe]] via [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] on Shyre, causing the mechanic to lose his memories of the past few days. As a result, Shyre not only forgot about Starkiller and Kota, but also his last encounter with Eclipse.<ref name="TFU2n" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You've been in a funk ever since that friend of yours was killed. I don't know who he was or what happened to him, but I can tell what he meant to you. I can read you, and I know you needed to grieve for him, for what you lost; believe me, I understand that all too well. But it's been over a year now. Don't you think it's time to move on?|Berkelium Shyre, to Juno Eclipse|<ref name="TFU2n" />}}
Berkelium Shyre was an expert technician who was also extremely loyal to the Rebel Alliance. Though forced to cope with the condition of being a cyborg from the waist down, the high [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] on his adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|home planet]] of Malastare greatly strengthened the upper Human half of Shyre's body. Outwardly, Shyre was an enthusiastic supporter of the Rebellion and a firm believer in its cause for freedom against the Galactic Empire. However, Juno Eclipse noticed how Shyre's face physically reflected the psychological strain of secretly supporting an insurrectionist movement against a galactic-wide hegemonic force.<ref name="TFU2n" />

He sympathized with Juno Eclipse, regarding her feelings of loss and remorse over the death of Galen Marek. Although Shyre did not know the identity of the man whom Eclipse loved, he nevertheless attempted to support Eclipse emotionally as a friend. As their time together wore on, however, his attraction to her became romantic. Ultimately, Shyre hoped to develop a relationship with Eclipse on Malastare. From Eclipse's perspective, Shyre was smart, loyal, brave and good-humored; an overall good man.<ref name="TFU2n" />

==Behind the scenes==
Berkelium Shyre first appeared in [[Sean Williams]]'s [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|novelization]]<ref name="TFU2n" /> of the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.<ref name="TFU2vg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>
